title: LAAX full catalog curation - Flims Laax Falera destination and access correction
summary: Rebuilds PR #21 on current main. Flims, Laax, and Falera are separate stay destinations in one Flims Laax Falera trip market; Laax Dorf and Laax Murschetg are separated into distinct stay bases; and all four base-to-mountain relationships point to one connected LAAX ski area. The report records the shared pass, current official trail map, published Winter 2025/26 season, terrain and feature facts, and reproducible access geometry without inventing a terrain domain or copying village facts across owners.
